title:
The AI guesses.
The hooman decides.
say: This is Hooman in the Loop: a free phone app for checking what an A.I. found in your images. You swipe to judge each result, draw to fix the mistakes, and export clean answers for your next model. Let me show you how it works.

title: Open it in your phone's browser
say: Open the app in your phone's browser, at deke one yahav dot github dot I O, slash hooman. Add it to your home screen, and it works offline, like any other app. There's no account and no server. Everything stays on your phone.

title: Try an example deck
say: A set of cards is called a deck. Tap Try an example, and pick Model A versus model B. The first time, the app asks your name, so your answers can be told apart from a colleague's.

title: Swipe to answer
say: Each card shows one cell. Model A's outline is red, model B's is green, and the dashed box shows where to look. Swipe left if A is right, and right if B is right. Down means unsure, and the buttons do the same thing. Made a mistake? Tap undo.

title: Zoom, outlines and contrast
say: Tap the image to zoom, and pinch to look closer. The coloured chips hide or show each model's outlines. The half moon button sets the contrast, so even dim microscopy is easy to see.

title: Both wrong? Draw the right mask
say: When both models are wrong, swipe up, and the mask editor opens. Start from a model, then fix it. The magic wand fills a cell with one tap, cut splits merged cells, merge joins pieces, and the brush, contour and polygon tools draw by hand. Save, and the corrected mask is stored with your answer.

title: See the results
say: The results screen shows how often each answer was given, with ninety five percent confidence intervals. Load a colleague's export, and you see how much you agree, and the exact cards you disagree on.

title: Time-lapse with several channels
say: Microscopy works too. This deck has raw sixteen bit images, three time points and two channels. Switch between the channels, mix them in colour, or put them side by side. Play runs through the time points, and keeps the view you chose.

title: Make your own deck with AI
say: To make a deck from your own images, tap Make a deck with A.I. Copy the prompt into Chat G P T, Claude or Gemini, and attach your images. The A.I. reads the app's published format, and gives you a deck to import. Claude users can add the ready made Hooman skill.

title: Or straight from your photos
say: For a quick question, you don't even need an A.I. New deck from photos takes pictures from your phone, asks your question, and you're swiping in seconds.

title: Export, share and back up
say: When you're done, export the answers. You get a spreadsheet, the full history, and every mask you drew, ready to give back to your A.I. Share a deck with a colleague as a file or a link, and back everything up from settings.

title: deke1yahav.github.io/hooman
say: Hooman in the Loop is free and open source. Try it today. The A.I. guesses. The hooman decides.
